origin_lemma.etymology: 6145 dádhāti 'places, lays on, gives, seizes' RV. [Already in RV. there was some contact of meaning with dádāti, and in meaning 'beats' it collides with it also phonetically in Kaf. and Dard. There is similar confusion in Iranian (e.g. Shgh. δā- 'to give' and δā- 'to put, strike') Rep¹ 78, NTS i 53. For semantic development 'sets, places — strikes' cf. lāgayati in Kaf. and K., and Or. basāibā 'to set, flog' s.v. vāsáyati². — Disappearance over most of MIA. and NIA. field due to collision with dáhati. — √dhā]
